text_block_list.text: The Fan Appreciation Festival, an event at Tracen Academy primarily aimed at interacting with fans, drew near.

With a buoyant excitement lingering throughout the academy,
Curren Bouquetd'or—
Leading up to the Tenno Sho (Spring), she spent her days with stoic dedication.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Gasp... ngk...!
...Haa, haa...!!
choice_data_list: Good work, let's take a look at the heart rate monitor.

text_block_list.text: (Beep-beep...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Maximum oxygen uptake—
Lactate threshold... Both remain unchanged.
choice_data_list: Let's try increasing the load for the interval training.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: *Haa, fuu, haa, fuu*...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much... for today as well.
choice_data_list: ...Is it not too painful for you?
...Is it not too tough on you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm fine.
While I do hit a wall sometimes—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It is something I must accomplish, after all.
I'll do my very best.
—Or so Curren Bouquetd'or said, anyway.
choice_data_list: (I really am a little concerned, though.)

text_block_list.text: Continuously taking on a formidable challenge like the Tenno Sho (Spring)... it's only natural for one's spirit to wear down.
Isn't there anything I can do?
And so—time passed, leading up to the Fan Appreciation Festival.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"My, we certainly have quite a crowd.
Look, over in front of the 'Fan Appreciation Festival' sign—"

text_block_list.name: Thanksgiving Executive Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
"Bouquet-san,
please get ready for the handshake event soon!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, you've been watching me
since the Sweetpea Stakes?
Hehe, thank you for supporting me all this time.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!
I'll be cheering you on forever and ever!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah―― And one last thing, this!
It's a present for you...!
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Oh, flowers—?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Fufuâwhat lovely sweet peas.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Especially your performance in the Classic class—
Seeing you always give it your all and deliver solid
results gave me so much courage!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Such kind words...
Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"A-And lastly, this! Please, let me
give you these flowers!"

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: My dream is to enroll in Tracen Academy someday and become a Tiara Umamusume just like you!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Do your best—I'll be cheering for you.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Th-Th-Thank you very much!!
Ah, flowers...! Here! I love them!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
My—
Thank you very much.

Flowers were handed to Curren Bouquetd'or by fans, one by one.
...And then.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: It turned into a big, beautiful bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—So pretty. It smells lovely.
Thank you for even wrapping it up.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
However... for everyone to give me just one each,
as if they'd planned it together.
Just why did they—?
Met with those probing eyes, I hastily tilt my head in confusion.
choice_data_list: Do you mean everyone's cheering and support?

text_block_list.text: —It wasn't entirely a lie, either.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"You're Bouquet-chan's Trainer, right?
I just heard about the flower surprise from the staff."

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: The flowers safely reached everyone as well.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I hope they'll like it.
They've been working so, so hard, after all.

The fans' hearts were as one.
That is precisely why the surprise was such a success.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...
...Well, hehe.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
May I display these in the trainer's office?
Someday, I'd like to turn them into dried flowers too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
So that I can always remember
your kind words and the warmth of your hand—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*——*exhale*...
...Just then, a card slipped out from the bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
――
Is this... a message card?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "Many Tiara Umamusume are currently making huge waves"—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Led by the prodigious Almond Eye,
everyone blossomed and danced in their own unique way—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "You, too, are one of those flowers. To me, you are a truly exceptional foam flower."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ""I'm sure you can achieve your goals for this spring's challenges too. We're all cheering you on!""

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "From All of Your Fans"...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
My—what a heartwarming message
you have given me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
A single flower true to myself. A special bouquet—
...Even if I'm full of nothing but such wishes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: You've all been watching over me, haven't you? This entire time.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*——*exhale*...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
Yeah, let's do our best.
